label: Pseudomonas putida KT2440

label: Rhodococcus erythropolis
description: Aerobic actinomycete with broad xenobiotic catabolism. Uses F420-dependent oxidoreductases (FDR-A/FDR-B family) to reduce the bisfuran ring of aflatoxin B1, opening the toxic lactone and disabling the CYP1A2-derived exo-8,9-epoxide bioactivation route. Distinct from mammalian bioactivation.

label: R. erythropolis AFB1-reductase module
description: F420-dependent oxidoreductase system for the reduction and detoxification of aflatoxin B1. Substrate: AFB1; product: less-toxic reduced AFB1 species.

label: AFB1 reductase (inferred F420H2-dependent, R. erythropolis)
description: AFB1 reductase activity in R. erythropolis cell-free extracts (Teniola 2005, PMID 16061299). Cofactor attribution to F420H2 is inferred by homology to the widespread Actinomycetales FDR-A family (Lapalikar 2012, PMID 22383957); no R. erythropolis-specific cofactor identification is published.

label: Rhodococcus sp. RHA1 (with R. ruber ENV425 co-reference)
description: Rhodococcus sp. RHA1 (Sharp 2007, PMID 17873074) and Rhodococcus ruber ENV425 (Fournier 2009, PMID 19542346) are the two characterized aerobic NDMA-degrading actinomycetes; both encode an inducible propane monooxygenase that oxidizes N-nitrosodimethylamine to methylamine and formaldehyde. RHA1 is the primary reference strain in the graph; ENV425 is co-cited on the module and edges.

label: RHA1 NDMA-degradation module (with ENV425 co-reference)
description: Inducible aerobic propane monooxygenase (prmABCD-like) oxidizes NDMA to methylamine and formaldehyde in Rhodococcus sp. RHA1 (Sharp 2007) and R. ruber ENV425 (Fournier 2009); a bacterial route absent from the human host, whose CYP2E1 instead bioactivates NDMA to DNA-methylating species.

label: Propane-monooxygenase homolog for NDMA (Rhodococcus sp. RHA1)
description: Aerobic soluble propane-monooxygenase-family enzyme; initiates NDMA oxidation.

label: Aflatoxin B1
description: Mycotoxin from Aspergillus flavus and A. parasiticus; potent liver carcinogen via CYP1A2/3A4-derived exo-8,9-epoxide.

label: AFB1 reduced product
description: Bacterial reduction product of the AFB1 bisfuran; cannot form the mammalian exo-8,9-epoxide. Strain-specific activity from Teniola 2005 (PMID 16061299); F420H2 mechanism from Lapalikar 2012 (PMID 22383957).

label: N-Nitrosodimethylamine
description: Small volatile nitrosamine; potent CYP2E1 substrate in mammalian bioactivation to methylating species.

label: Methylamine

label: Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron VPI-5482
description: Abundant colonic Bacteroidetes; two catabolic modules relevant to xenobiotic handling. Azoreductase activity reduces aromatic-amine precursors; beta-glucuronidase deconjugates host-glucuronidated substrates including AFB1-N7-guanine glucuronide, releasing free carcinogen back into the lumen.

label: B. thetaiotaomicron gut azo-reduction module
description: FMN-dependent azoreductase system; reductive cleavage of azo bonds. Handles aromatic amine precursor substrates including azo-linked benzidine and aminobiphenyl dyes. [CAVEAT] CAVEAT - a B. thetaiotaomicron-specific enzymology paper would be stronger; alternative supporting primary source: Rafii F, Franklin W, Cerniglia CE, Appl Environ Microbiol 1990, PMID 2202258, doi:10.1128/aem.56.7.2146-2151.1990.

label: B. thetaiotaomicron beta-glucuronidase deconjugation module
description: Gut microbial beta-glucuronidase (GUS) family; hydrolyzes host-conjugated glucuronides in the intestinal lumen, releasing free aglycones back for reabsorption. Relevant to AFB1 detoxification counter-currents and other host-glucuronidated carcinogens. [CAVEAT] CAVEAT - AFB1-N7-guanine glucuronide is not itself an assayed substrate here, so that specific compound edge remains inferred.

label: Mycobacterium vanbaalenii PYR-1
description: Aerobic actinomycete; canonical bacterial degrader of high-molecular-weight PAHs including pyrene, chrysene, and benzo[a]pyrene. Uses ring-hydroxylating dioxygenases (NidAB, PdoAB) that attack multiple ring positions in BaP, producing cis-dihydrodiols that feed downstream aerobic catabolism. label: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii A2-165
description: Abundant obligate-anaerobe butyrate producer in the healthy human colon. Encodes arsenate reductase (ArsC) and arsenite efflux transporter (ArsB/Acr3) for arsenic tolerance; contributes to reductive arsenic transformations in the gut lumen, distinct from ArsM-mediated methylation.

label: F. prausnitzii gut arsenic-tolerance module
description: Arsenate reductase (ArsC) and arsenite efflux transporter (ArsB/Acr3) system. label: Monomethylarsonic acid

label: Dimethylarsinic acid
description: Dimethylated arsenic species; downstream methylation product of arsenite via MMA; principal urinary excretion form in fast-methylator individuals.

label: Extracellular arsenite As(III)

label: Methylated arsenicals (MMA/DMA/TMA)
